estimator_change: keep v1 branch, then test its same reversal gates on the remaining regional-affine/temporal-mean-orthogonal motion residual
gates: dominant residual mode >=0.5; reversal >0.5; participation >=0.1; pair proxy coverage >=0.6; leave-region/time prediction gain >0.5; nondegenerate basis
projection: same constrained_mode_residual; protect per-region instantaneous affine motion and per-point time mean; no deletion at unknown pairs
score_head: unchanged full-grid top5-percent continuous intensity and frozen I/(I+tau)
counterfactual: same 32 official DEV MP4s, same 8 native pixels, same two seeds, all 128 inputs; no construction changes
natural_control: all 63 separately scored natural development MP4s; no refit of the frozen scale
primary_statistic: 32 equal-weight sources; average two CF seeds within source; signed mean(CF)-mean(base)
acceptance: report actual reduction and natural-score changes; <=10% of Origin drift remains the numerical target, not a tuning objective or a claim of motion validity
limitations: reused development inputs; retained SAM regions and track visibility are not physical ground truth; true nonaffine oscillation may be suppressed
